title: SMS inbox
subtitle: Inbound payment texts for this country. Replay stays on SMS Formats.
pickCountry: Choose one country in the sidebar. All countries still opens the Lesotho API, so this inbox does not load until you pick Lesotho, Benin, or Zambia.
thresholdUnset: Not set. Exact connection-fee amounts still classify as fees.
thresholdSet: Payments at or above {{amount}} {{currency}} classify as a connection fee, unless the account is exempt or the fee is already verified.
phoneNone: No account is stored against that phone.
exemptHelp: Only fee admins can change this. It skips the threshold rule. An exact connection-fee amount still classifies as a fee.
